privacy.rightsLabel: WHAT YOU CAN DO FROM THIS APP
privacy.localBody: Your conversations, memories and household profiles are kept on your Pond. There is no account with us, and no server of ours holding them. The language models your Pond ships with run on the Pond itself.
privacy.storageBody: API keys you give your Pond are encrypted on disk. Its other data — conversations, memories, profiles and face templates — is not encrypted by the Pond, so protect the computer it runs on as you would any device holding personal information.
privacy.networkBody: Some features need the internet: weather comes from Open-Meteo, encyclopedia lookups from Wikipedia, and music from Spotify once you connect it. Keys you add turn on more: Wolfram|Alpha for calculations, and Brave for web search, which sends your question to Brave and reads the top result pages from their own sites. Your Pond keeps a record of every outbound call it makes, and can be set to refuse sensitive destinations or to stay offline entirely.
privacy.voiceBody: Speech is transcribed on your Pond by default, and the recording is not kept afterwards. What you said is kept as text, as part of the conversation. The wake word is detected on your Pond, not on this phone.
privacy.facesBody: If you enrol a face, your Pond keeps a numerical template of it and never the photo. Removing a household member deletes their face data with them.
privacy.rightSignOut: Sign out to release this phone’s access to your Pond, including its remote access.
privacy.rightRemoveMember: Remove a household member under Users, and their face data goes with them.
privacy.rightsHeading: What you can do from this app

commission.aim: Point the camera at the QR code on the device or its packaging
commission.camera: Scanning a device setup code needs the camera. You can also type the code printed on the device instead.
commission.notSetupCode: That is not a Matter setup code. Look for a QR beginning MT: on the device or its box.
commission.isPondCode: That is your Pond’s pairing code, not a device setup code. This phone is already paired — scan the QR on the device itself, or on its packaging.
commission.desc: Scan or enter the setup code printed on the device or its packaging. A device only accepts pairing for about 15 minutes after it starts up, so power-cycle it first if it has been sitting.
commission.addingDesc: This can take a couple of minutes. Keep the device powered and nearby.
commission.controllerStarting: Your Pond is still starting its Matter controller. Adding a device will not work until it has finished.
commission.bluetoothFootnote: A device straight out of the box has no Wi-Fi yet and can only be reached over Bluetooth. If it is not found, turn on Bluetooth pairing in your Pond’s Matter settings and try again.

dev.devOnly: This screen is dev-only. It is not linked from the You tab in production builds.

list.noSchedulesBody: A schedule has Goose run a prompt for you on a timer, once or on repeat.
list.noRulesBody: An automation has Goose act when a sensor or device reports something.
list.polling: Live updates are paused. This list refreshes every 30 seconds.
list.rulesNote: Automations run when a reading matches, so they have no Run now.

runs.title: Recent runs
runs.none: This schedule has not run yet.
runs.failed: Could not load this schedule's runs.

form.name: Name
form.automationPlaceholder: Too warm in the living room
form.cronHint: Six fields, seconds first: second minute hour day month weekday. 0 0 9 * * 1-5 is 9:00 on weekdays.
form.promptPlaceholder: Summarise my calendar and the weather.

errors.whenRequired: Choose a date and a time.
errors.cronFields: A cron expression here has six fields. The first is seconds and must be a single number, such as 0.
errors.valueRequired: A condition needs a number to compare against.
errors.actionIncomplete: Finish the action: it is missing something it needs.
errors.cooldownInvalid: The wait has to be a whole number of seconds.
errors.createFailed: Your Pond could not create it. Try again in a moment.
errors.gone: That one is no longer on your Pond.
errors.noScheduler: Your Pond is running without its scheduler, so it cannot keep schedules.

remote.title: Access your Pond from anywhere
remote.description: Keep using your Pond away from home through an encrypted private connection. Your Pond must approve remote access locally.
remote.unconfigured: Remote access is not set up on this Pond yet. Its operator must configure the coordination and relay service before cellular access can work. Local pairing is ready to use.
remote.approval: Approve remote access on your Pond, then try again.
remote.failed: Remote access could not be enabled. Your local pairing is preserved.
remote.recover: Recover remote access after local re-pairing
remote.alreadyEnrolled: This phone is already set up for remote access. If you paired with your Pond again, use Recover below to re-issue its remote address.
remote.replacementBlocked: Your Pond could not re-issue this phone’s remote address. Try again in a moment, or sign out and pair again if it keeps failing.
remote.review: Approve this recovery request on your Pond dashboard. Keep this phone on the home network.
remote.reviewCode: Match this request on the Pond: {{id}}
remote.reviewKey: Approve it only if the Pond shows this phone's name and a key beginning {{key}}
remote.reviewExpired: Local approval expired. Request recovery again while on the home network.
remote.identityStale: Your Pond would not take this phone back for remote access, even with new keys. Your local pairing is preserved. Sign out and pair again at home if it keeps failing.
remote.busy: Remote access setup is already running.
remote.unsupported: Remote access requires the latest native Goose app.

connection.changePond: Scan a local QR code to change the paired Pond.
connection.disconnected: Pond is unavailable. Check its connection and remote access status.
connection.unpaired: Pair with your Pond at home
connection.upgrade: Scan a new QR code at home to enable secure connections.
connection.revoked: Your Pond no longer recognises this phone. Tap to pair again at home.
connection.trust: Could not verify this Pond. Check its fingerprint on the Pond before pairing again.
connection.unsupported: Secure Pond connections require an Android or iOS development or release build.

errors.busy: Your Pond is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: Your Pond could not complete that request.
errors.deviceGone: That device is no longer registered with your Pond.
errors.bridgedEndpoint: Your Pond will not remove a bridged endpoint on its own.
errors.noModelCatalogue: This Pond does not expose a model catalogue.
errors.profileExists: A profile with that name already exists.

sessions.emptyMessage: Start a chat to see it here.

homeManagementAlert.removeBody: Are you sure you want to remove this room?

scanErrors.matterCode: That is a Matter device setup code, not a Pond pairing code. Use Devices, then Add device, to commission it. The pairing code is the one on your Pond dashboard.
scanErrors.notPondCode: That is not a Goose In A Pond pairing code. Open Pairing on your Pond and scan the code it shows.

pairingErrors.rateLimited: Your Pond is rate-limiting pairing attempts. Wait {{count}} second{{plural}} and try again.
pairingErrors.rateLimitedNoHint: Your Pond is rate-limiting pairing attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
pairingErrors.serverError: Your Pond returned an error while pairing. Check that it is still running, then try again.
pairingErrors.refused: Your Pond refused the pairing request. Check the code on its dashboard and try again.
pairingErrors.unreachable: Could not reach your Pond. Check that the phone is on the same network and the server is running.
pairingErrors.badCode: That pairing code did not match. Check the six digits on your Pond and try again. After 10 wrong tries the Pond retires the code and you will need a new one.
pairingErrors.codeRetired: Too many wrong codes were tried, so your Pond has retired this pairing code. Show a new code on your Pond's dashboard and pair again.
pairingErrors.expired: This attempt took too long — the server holds a challenge for only 60 seconds. Enter the same code again; you do not need a new one.
pairingErrors.noCode: Your Pond has no pairing code right now. Codes last 10 minutes — open the dashboard on the host machine to show a fresh one.
pairingErrors.rejected: The server rejected the pairing attempt. Double-check the code and try again.
pairingErrors.pondOutdated: This Pond is too old to pair with this version of the app. Update the software on your Pond, then try again.

list.failed: Could not load memories from your Pond.
list.emptyBody: Goose learns from your conversations, or you can add something it should know.

memories.forgetBody: Goose will no longer know it. This cannot be undone.

form.contentPlaceholder: Prefers tea over coffee in the morning
form.segmentHint: Optional. It sets how much this memory matters and how quickly it fades.
form.keepHint: A kept memory never fades with time, and a tidy-up will not drop it.

consolidate.title: Tidy up memories
consolidate.body: Goose reviews what it knows, merges repeats and drops what is out of date. Each change is challenged before it is made.
consolidate.notEnabled: Tidying up is switched off on your Pond. Turn on memory consolidation in its settings.
consolidate.mock: Switch Memories to the real Pond on the Developer screen to tidy up.

errors.keepNeedsUpdate: Your Pond needs an update before it can change whether a memory is kept.

devMode.insecureBannerDetail: Pond traffic may be plaintext and unpinned. Anyone on this network can read it.
devMode.addressHint: Development mode: a plain http:// address on this network is accepted and is not encrypted.

ride.offerBody: Get an Uber fare from where you are now. Your location is used for this ride only. Nothing is booked until you confirm.
ride.pickupIn: A driver could reach you in about {{minutes}} min.
ride.cancelNote: Uber may charge a cancellation fee.
ride.closedFailed: Uber could not book this ride. Nothing was booked.

status.accepted: A driver is on the way.

problem.locationDenied: Location is off for Goose On The Go, so no fare could be asked for. Turn it on in Settings to get a fare.
problem.notLinked: This phone is not linked to a member of your household, so it cannot book rides.
problem.notSetUp: Your Pond is not set up to book rides yet. Connect Uber on the Pond first.
problem.expired: That fare has expired. Get a new one.
problem.alreadyDecided: This ride was already booked or turned down.
problem.notFound: This ride is no longer on your Pond.
problem.refused: Uber turned this down. Nothing was booked.
problem.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was booked.
